# Trump approval rating slips among Alabama voters, new poll finds

Jennifer Lindahl Bonnie Bolden Fernando Cervantes Jr.

Montgomery Advertiser

Updated Sept. 3, 2026, 1:50 p.m. CT

President Donald Trump’s approval rating among Alabama voters has slipped in recent weeks, according to the latest Civiqs polling, even as he continues to hold a positive overall rating in the state.
results.title: Trump approval rating slips among Alabama voters, new poll finds

results.content:
Then there’s the economy. In Civiqs’ tracking, 75% of registered voters rated the national economy as good and just 18% as bad at this point in 2018. Today, that’s flipped: 33% good and 64% bad. There’s a night and day difference in voter perceptions of the economy now versus 2018.

Another question is: how easily can you blame the person in charge for the number one problem facing the country? In the voters’ minds, who’s holding the murder weapon?
